annotation: Home-city slot-body fixtures authored from the 2026-09-22 157_farm V44 evidence session, the 2026-09-29 V44-4 driver-correction sessions (157_farm castle under both 1721bc67 and f1171ffa), the authorized 2026-09-30 ef03789c turn020 survey frames that measured the slot-3 Warehouse body, the fixed sys_1/5001 Bank body, the four single-type military bodies at slots 5 through 8, and the multi-slot Moon Well body, and the 2026-10-01 v44-q4-bank-watchtower live endpoint frame. Sources stay RGBA 900x1600 through production-publisher tests: tests pass source.copy() to the builder and never pre-convert to RGB. Only declared private-chat rows 1390 through 1484 inclusive are masked solid black; every other pixel is source-identical and the RGBA mode is preserved. raw_sha256 hashes the PNG file bytes; sha256 is the decoded RGB digest width.to_bytes(8,big)+height.to_bytes(8,big)+RGB bytes, matching the home_city_camera convention. Slot tags record the slot the body was measured at on these saved views; they are current-frame observations, not universal occupancy.
